description: This script collects pull request data from a GitHub repository, processes contributor information, and updates contributor and translator YAML files accordingly. It defines data models, fetches PRs through GraphQL API calls, and manages Git operations for updating files and creating pull requests.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents a GitHub user who is an author or reviewer in pull requests.

classes.name: LabelNode
classes.description: Represents a label node in GitHub's pull request labels.

classes.name: Labels
classes.description: Contains a list of label nodes associated with a pull request.

classes.name: ReviewNode
classes.description: Represents a review on a pull request, including the reviewer and review state.

classes.name: Reviews
classes.description: Contains a list of review nodes for a pull request.

classes.name: PullRequestNode
classes.description: Represents a pull request with its metadata, labels, author, reviews, and status.

classes.name: PullRequestEdge
classes.description: Edge in the pull request GraphQL response, containing cursor and node.

classes.name: PullRequests
classes.description: Contains a list of pull request edges.

classes.name: PRsRepository
classes.description: Repository wrapper in the GraphQL response, containing pull requests.

classes.name: PRsResponseData
classes.description: Data wrapper for the GraphQL response.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for GitHub token, repository, and HTTP timeout.

classes.name: ContributorsResults
classes.description: Aggregation of contributors, translators, reviewers, and authors extracted from PR data.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Executes a GraphQL POST request to the GitHub API and returns the parsed JSON data.

methods.name: list[PullRequestEdge] get_graphql_pr_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )
methods.description: Fetches pull request edges from GitHub GraphQL API, handling pagination.

methods.name: list[PullRequestNode] get_pr_nodes(settings: Settings)
methods.description: Retrieves all pull request nodes by paging through all edges.

methods.name: ContributorsResults get_contributors(pr_nodes: list[PullRequestNode])
methods.description: Analyzes PRs to compute counters of contributors, translators, and reviewers.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_users_to_write( *, counter: Counter[str], authors: dict[str, Author], min_count: int = 2, )
methods.description: Filters contributors based on minimum count and prepares their data for output.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Writes new content to a YAML file if it has changed, otherwise does nothing.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main execution flow: fetch PRs, process contributors, update files, commit, and create PR.
